title: SIGNAL
objective: Parse the binary signal stream protocol to extract the embedded telemetry payload.
technicalMechanism: The file contains binary packets framed with magic bytes 'NXS\x01', a 1-byte type header, a 2-byte big-endian length, and payload bytes. Parsing Packet Type 2 yields the flag.
hintLevels: Read README.txt for the packet framing specification: Magic (4B), Type (1B), Length (2B Big-Endian), Payload.
Write a Python script to scan for 0x4E585301 and read the packet header fields.
Extract the payload from Packet Type 2 (Data Payload) to recover flag{Signal_Packet_Framing_Decoded}.

title: THE IMAGE
objective: Extract and decode hidden telemetry data stored within a custom PNG chunk in nexus_telemetry.png.
technicalMechanism: The PNG file contains a custom ancillary chunk named 'nxDS'. Extracting the raw payload of 'nxDS' and XOR decoding with mask 0x77 reveals the flag string.
hintLevels: Inspect the PNG file structure using pngcheck, zsteg, or a custom Python script to list all PNG chunk types.
Notice the non-standard ancillary chunk named 'nxDS' situated before IDAT.
Extract the data bytes of chunk 'nxDS' and XOR each byte with 0x77 to decode flag{PNG_Chunk_Steganography_Extracted}.

title: GHOST ARTIFACT
objective: Carve and decode the classified payload from the custom NXC container archive ghost_archive.nxc.
technicalMechanism: The .nxc file uses a custom binary directory structure with magic 'NXCv1.0\0'. Solvers parse directory entries to find Type 3 (CLASSIFIED / REC-GHOST-99) and XOR decode with mask 0x44.
hintLevels: Review the NXC file format specification in README.txt. Parse the 8-byte magic and 4-byte record count.
Iterate over 26-byte directory entries to locate the record where type == 3 (CLASSIFIED record REC-GHOST-99).
Read the payload bytes at offset off3 for len3 bytes, then XOR with 0x44 to reveal flag{Ghost_Binary_Container_Carved}.
